newsitem.title: POLAND: SWARZEDZ DUE TO MEET CREDITORS APRIL 7.
newsitem.headline: SWARZEDZ DUE TO MEET CREDITORS APRIL 7.

text.p: Polish furniture maker SFM Swarzedz SA is due to meet with its creditors on April 7 to discuss the restructuring of its debts, the company said in a statement on Friday.

Swarzedz, which owes its creditors 60.5 million zlotys, has earlier announced reaching a preliminary agreement with main creditors under which they would purchase 3.1 million new Swarzedz shares, proceeds from which would serve to pay off debts.
In February Swarzedz shareholders approved a new issue of up to 6.625 million shares, out of which 3.1 million are earmarked for debt-for-equity swap and 3.5 million for a one-for-four rights issue.
Swarzedz reported a loss of 39.5 million zlotys in 1996.
